title: Valid Palindrome III
goal: Decide whether removing at most k characters can leave a palindrome.
strategy: Interval DP stores the fewest deletions needed for each substring. Equal ends can remain around the inner solution; unequal ends require deleting one endpoint and choosing the cheaper remaining interval.
